title: Experimental study on the motion characteristics and critical hydraulic parameters of microplastics in a freshwater environment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00574K, Paper
Ming Dou, Zhen Wang, Yuxuan Li, Bin Sun, Yongyong Zhang, Yuze Zhou, Ruipeng Jia
The migration behavior of microplastics in water is affected by many factors; in particular, the migration mechanism of microplastics in the terrestrial freshwater environment is more complicated than that in the marine environment.
